title: Mentor Accelerator — 10-Day Technical Shadow Playbook (People Ops draft)
content:
Purpose:
Enable faster ramp and stronger first-release impact by pairing new technical hires with a structured 10-day mentor shadow sequence. This playbook codifies goals, day-by-day activities, interviewer/mentor scripts, evaluation rubrics, and minimal tooling/accesses needed for an engineer to ship meaningful work in their first month.

Scope and intended audience:
- Audience: people-ops, hiring managers, mentors, hiring panel members, and the new hire.
- Scope: compact technical roles (IC2–IC4) joining product and platform teams. Not intended for senior management or long-term leadership onboards.

Goals (measurable):
1) 10-day completion rate >= 90% (participants + mentors complete checklist).
2) After 10 days, new hire has at least 1 accepted small-ticket PR or a documented design note.
3) Hiring manager confidence score >= 4/5 on readiness rubric at day 10.
4) Mentor satisfaction >= 4/5 with quality of prompts and outcomes.
5) Time-to-first-PR median <= 14 days for cohort.

High-level hiring-plan alignment:
- This playbook is attached to offer acceptance as the default ramp for technical ICs whose role profile includes cross-pod collaboration and shipping within 30 days. Hiring managers choose the mentor from their pod during final offer steps. People Ops coordinates mentor stipend and scheduling.

Interview rubric (summary for final-stage calibration):
- Scope: applied coding, systems reasoning, debugging mindset, collaboration signals.
- Quick scoring: 1-5 scale across four axes (Problem Solving, Systems Intuition, Ownership/Communication, Learning Velocity).
- Pass threshold: >= 14/20 with no zeroes on Ownership.
- Notes for interviewers: record the most persuasive signal (code artifact, system diagram, or debugging story) and provide one concrete advice item for day 1.

10-Day Shadow Schedule (daily objectives + mentor prompts):
Day 0 — Preboarding checklist (People Ops, before start date):
- Access: GitHub org, internal wiki, Slack, VPN, issue tracker (assign minimal perms).
- Hardware: laptop imaged, manager confirmed.
- Paperwork: policy, benefits, NDA signed.
- Prework: short reading list + repo map (deliver link to new hire).

Day 1 — Orientation & repo walkthrough (goal: orientation + local dev):
- Morning: 30m with People Ops for orientation logistics.
- 1:1 with manager: role expectations, 30/60/90 outcomes.
- Mentor session: 60m repo tour and run-the-tests locally. Mentor prompt: "Help me get a green test and explain the main service boundaries."
- Deliverable: create a small fork/branch and submit a trivial doc update PR.

Day 2 — Read + triage small issues (goal: read architecture + pick a starter task):
- Mentor: pair on triaging the backlog for 60m; pick a low-risk bug or test fix.
- Deliverable: open an issue or claim an existing one with a proposed approach.

Day 3 — Pair programming (goal: complete first dev turnaround):
- Mentor: 2h pair on implementation plan, coding, and test additions.
- Deliverable: draft PR with basic tests and CI passing locally.

Day 4 — Independent iteration + async review (goal: land PR to staging):
- Mentor: asynchronous code review with 1h scheduled wrap-up.
- Deliverable: PR merged to staging or a clear merge plan.

Day 5 — Post-merge verification & ownership note (goal: monitor behavior and write a short ownership doc):
- Mentor: teach monitoring checks and alert runbooks.
- Deliverable: 1-page ownership note describing component boundaries, common failure modes, and where to route questions.

Day 6 — Cross-team sync & escalating dependencies (goal: partner with a downstream team):
- Mentor: introduce the hire to one downstream partner and shadow a sync.
- Deliverable: write an action list for dependency handoffs.

Day 7 — Mini-design exercise (goal: propose an incremental improvement):
- Mentor: 90m design workshop.
- Deliverable: 1-slide design + implementation plan and rough ETA.

Day 8 — Execute improvement spine (goal: ship an incremental change or prototype):
- Mentor: 2h check-in; unblock with PR guidance.
- Deliverable: PR or prototype linked in design note.

Day 9 — Stabilization & observability (goal: verify metrics, add a simple dashboard or alert):
- Mentor: teach observability patterns and acceptance criteria for incremental changes.
- Deliverable: dashboard widget or simple alert tied to the change.

Day 10 — Debrief and readiness check (goal: readiness evaluation and next-steps):
- 30m sync: new hire, mentor, manager. Use the readiness rubric below.
- Deliverable: signed-off 30/60/90 and assigned first sprint ticket.

Readiness rubric (day 10, quick):
- Local dev setup: 0-2 (0 not set, 2 fully working).
- First PR: 0-2 (0 none, 2 merged to staging).
- Ownership note quality: 0-2.
- Cross-team communication: 0-2.
- Manager confidence (subjective): 0-2.
- Pass: >= 7/10.

Mentor scripting and coaching tips (short):
- Kickoff: "Today I’ll show you how the service is wired and one place to make a small safe change."
- During pairing: ask the hire to explain back system boundaries; note gaps and give 1 specific learning item.
- Review feedback: be action-oriented. Provide 2 things they should keep doing and 1 thing to try differently.
- Timebox code reviews: respond within 24 hours during the 10-day window.

Onboarding checklist (minimum accesses + tasks):
- Accounts: Slack, Google, LDAP, VPN, GitHub, CI dashboard.
- Tooling: local container runtime, linter/config, test runner.
- Docs: architecture map, deployment runbook, incident triage doc.
- Administrative: payroll, expense tool, benefits.

Interview / hiring manager artifacts to attach at offer: 
- Mentor name + 3 suggested meeting blocks for first two weeks.
- Starter repo with two labeled starter-tasks (easy and medium).
- One-pager: expectations and first-PR acceptance criteria.

Risk register and mitigations (concise):
- Risk: mentor overloaded leads to delayed reviews. Mitigation: reserve 4 mentor-hours per hire in manager calendar; fallback mentor assigned.
- Risk: missing infra accesses. Mitigation: preflight access checklist run 48h pre-start by People Ops.
- Risk: hire not shipping to staging by day 10. Mitigation: schedule a manager-led unblock session and reduce scope to a docs/test PR to satisfy first-PR metric.

Feedback forms / templates (links are in linked_artifacts but minimal templates here):
- Mentor feedback (3 questions, 1-5): technical clarity, responsiveness, learning progression.
- New hire pulse (3 questions): clarity of expectations, ease of setup, psychological safety rating.

Implementation notes for People Ops (operational):
- Stipend: 2 hours mentor prep + 8 hours pairing per hire reimbursed as 1.5x time for managers who pick mentors outside their pod.
- Scheduling: People Ops auto-sends a 10-day calendar template linked to the new hire and mentor on acceptance.
- Measurement: track completion fields in one centralized sheet and surface weekly to the talent ops dashboard.

Next steps / owners (action items):
- Aisha: finalize playbook template and push to Confluence by 2025-06-20.
- Hiring managers: nominate mentors at offer step and add to offer packet.
- Dev leads: create two labelled starter-tasks per role and commit to triage backlog for hires.

Appendix — sample day-1 mentor intro script (copyable):
"Welcome. Today I’ll show you how to run and test the service locally, where the primary code paths live, and one small change you can make to ship a first PR. Ask me to explain anything you’d like me to repeat — we’ll pair for 60 minutes and then you’ll create a tiny PR to get your keyboard warm."

Notes on iteration: treat this playbook as living; run 4-week cohorts and revisit metrics after each cohort.
